Hero_Desc_Sparrot:
Sparrot, captain of the Iron Parrot Privateers.
A pirate who survived the whirlpool-ravaged Capricious Sea through overwhelming spirit and confidence.
To advance unflinchingly through every storm, Sparrot conducts a glorious departure ceremony.
Album_Like_Sparrot: Dumping troublesome work on her subordinates
Album_Hobby_Sparrot: Running scams, earning money through hostage schemes
Album_Sparrot1: While passing through the Beastfolk Forest, I heard a powerful shout from somewhere nearby. Pushing through the undergrowth, I found Sparrot sweating as she lifted a small rock. She said the training was essential for turning a ship's wheel with force, then told me not to interrupt and continue on my way.
Album_Sparrot2: Sparrot often introduces herself as a descendant of eagles. Standing before a mirror, she made grand gestures like an eagle soaring through the sky. Intoxicated by her own appearance, she excitedly declared that she wished to immortalize the moment as a picture upon her sail.
Album_Sparrot3: Wondering whether Sparrot might repeat words like a parrot, I teased her. She answered with a fierce gaze that seemed ready to make me walk the plank. Sparrot leaped in fury and shouted that she had overcome that habit long ago.
Album_Sparrot4: One day, Delia begged Sparrot for more adventure stories and pulled out a whole fistful of her feathers. With trembling hands, Sparrot carefully gathered them, bade them a tearful farewell, and set them adrift upon the sea.
Album_Sparrot5: On a morning when I had arranged to meet Sparrot early, she came running without even taming her sleep-tousled hair. Her parrots calmly arranged it with their beaks as though combing it. Does she normally leave her hair care to them?
Album_Sparrot6: Sparrot often inspects every corner of the Bread Cruiser closely. Does the thought of new crew members and becoming the ship's captain fill her heart with excitement? After surveying the ship proudly for quite some time, she fell asleep in a corner. I covered her with a warm blanket so she would not become cold.
Album_Sparrot7: Curious about the purpose of her hook, I asked Sparrot. With a serious expression, she answered that she used it to stab various things. Then she speared a large piece of Pirate King Meat and extended it directly before my mouth. Swept away by her proud confidence, I opened wide without even realizing it.
LoveHero_Sparrot: Yohohoho! Raise anchor! We depart at once, yaaaar!
LoveHeroCancel_Sparrot: Wh-What...?! Where do you think you are going, yaaaar!! Do not leave me behind~!
Food_ChefNote_Sparrot_Hate1: Sparrot said one bite brought back painful memories of her days as a lowly deckhand. She frowned and shook her head repeatedly.
Food_ChefNote_Sparrot_Hate2: She screamed that it was nothing like the familiar taste of coconut and looked utterly unable to swallow it.
Food_ChefNote_Sparrot_Like1: Saying the rich scent of grapes lifted her spirits, she spread her wings wide and laughed heartily.
Food_ChefNote_Sparrot_Like10: She smiled and cleaned her plate, saying it made her feel healthier. Then she promised to tell me adventure stories about the robust fellows she had encountered at sea.
Food_ChefNote_Sparrot_Like2: She sniffed the scent of gunpowder once, then boldly grabbed the food and declared she would swallow it immediately. She seemed quite satisfied by its faint gunpowder fragrance.
Food_ChefNote_Sparrot_Like3: She smiled comfortably, saying it slid easily down her throat and could be swallowed in one gulp even amid a fierce storm.
Food_ChefNote_Sparrot_Like4: She began an adventure story about a treasure she had seen that resembled this food, whose appearance differed from its flavor. Speaking with her mouth full, she seemed to like it.
Food_ChefNote_Sparrot_Like5: Sparrot found the tart flavor exhilarating, like the capricious sea itself.
Food_ChefNote_Sparrot_Like6: She lavished praise upon its many colors, saying they resembled her magnificent feathers.
Food_ChefNote_Sparrot_Like7: Saying the softly chewy texture kept drawing her hand back, she packed Almond Rochers as provisions for her next voyage upon the Capricious Sea.
Food_ChefNote_Sparrot_Like8: She was delighted, saying this would let her conduct departure ceremonies in an even more thunderous voice.
Food_ChefNote_Sparrot_Like9: After quietly studying the colorful candies, she laughed and said pirates, too, each possessed their own colors and distinctive qualities.

LoveLetter_Sparrot:
Yaaaaaar!! Master!

Something suddenly occurred to me, so I hurried to write this letter!
The great Sparrot has found a treasure map! Yohohoho!
Raise sail with me later! Yaaaar!!
You are the only one I have told, so keep it absolutely secret from those other noisy Apostles and quietly follow behind me!
Consider it an honor to have been chosen as the great Sparrot's sailing partner! Yohohoho!
LoveCall_Sparrot:
Ahem. Can you hear me? ...Hmm? Yoho... hohoho...
Hup...! Yaaaaaaar~!!!! Kahahaha!! Kukh-
Master! Were you surprised?! I shouted on purpose to startle you! Yohohoho!

Now that I think about it, Master, how does it feel to live as a privateer with me?
Hmm? You want me to answer first? I am extremely satisfied!
You are fairly quick-witted, often help with the work...
And most importantly, there is never a moment to be bored when you are around! Kukhukh-

Ahem... Th-Thank you! ...Yes! Gratitude is gratitude! Yaaaar!!
That is why you must remain right beside the great Sparrot!
Take good care of me from now on, Master! Yo-Yohohoho!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP01_001: Yaarrr! I am in an especially good mood today! Summon someone worthy of sharing this drink with me!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP01_003: N-no, never mind. Who knows what might happen if I meet that Elemental from the volcanic island?
Affinity_Sparrot_EP01_005: Indeed! Only someone with ambitions of that caliber makes a drink worth sharing!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP01_007: You mean the one who sometimes glares at me with that unsettling look? I doubt sharing a toast with her would be much fun.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP02_001: What qualities do you think a pirate needs?
Affinity_Sparrot_EP02_002: The boldness to laugh anything off without shame.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP02_003: Exactly! Take away a pirate's bravado and nothing remains! Yo-ho!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP02_004: An intellect worthy of being called genius.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP02_005: What matters at sea is not racking your brains. Think too long and you may be swept away before you know it.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP02_006: Enough money to keep everyone well fed.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP02_007: Half right and half wrong. Your crew might start coveting the gold and threaten their captain.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP03_001: Some Beastfolk youngsters asked why I became a pirate. What do you think I told them?
Affinity_Sparrot_EP03_003: Ironically, life at sea costs you a great deal of freedom.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP03_005: Right. What other answer could there be? Yet after I told them, they stared at me with strangely disappointed eyes.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP03_006: Because you were unemployed and had too much time.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP03_007: Are you not taking pirates far too lightly, Master?
Affinity_Sparrot_EP04_001: Yaarrr, the land is far less entertaining than the sea.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP04_002: That is because you do not know the truly fun places. I will take you to one.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP04_003: Yo-ho? Are you taking me somewhere with treasure? Lead the way at once!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP04_004: Is the sea not more dangerous than entertaining?
Affinity_Sparrot_EP04_005: Heh heh heh. Have you never considered that the danger is precisely what makes it thrilling and fun, Master?
Affinity_Sparrot_EP04_006: I found the sea more boring.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP04_007: You owned such a large ship, yet you say that...? I suppose it is fortunate that I am the captain now.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP05_001: Yo-ho? Where is this Order's treasure vault?
Affinity_Sparrot_EP05_002: The Order itself is the treasure vault. It holds Apostles more precious than any treasure.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP05_003: ...I feel as though I may become seasick at any moment.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP05_004: Here. Take this gold coin and be satisfied.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP05_005: Grr, I already know that is chocolate! How dare you try to fool me?!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP05_006: As though I would tell you where such an important place is.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP05_007: Heh heh heh... I was merely probing you, but it seems the Order truly does have a treasure vault!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP06_001: Master, would you say, 'Want to give this a try?'
Affinity_Sparrot_EP06_002: Want to give this a try?
Affinity_Sparrot_EP06_003: Yaaaaarrr!! You finally said it! Now present terms worthy of negotiation!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP06_004: Did you not say those words first? Well, what can you offer?
Affinity_Sparrot_EP06_005: G-grr... To think you would turn it back on me. You truly have the makings of a pirate, Master.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP06_006: As if I would. Once last time was more than enough.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP07_001: Have you ever faced a mutiny aboard your ship, Master?
Affinity_Sparrot_EP07_003: Heh heh heh~ It is written all over your face, Master. It seems you have been driven out at least once.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP07_004: Before I answer, let me ask you first. How does it feel to suffer a mutiny?
Affinity_Sparrot_EP07_005: Grr...! Do not rub salt into an old wound! And answering a question with another question is poor manners!!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP07_007: Hahaha... Huh? Truly? You survived several mutinies without being sent to the Weekend Fishing Grounds? How?!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP08_001: Every dish in this Banquet Hall is ill suited to life at sea. They would spoil in no time.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP08_003: They are provisions with two edges. The crew may reveal their greed by fighting over one extra piece.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP08_004: Nothing suits life at sea better than ship's biscuit.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP08_005: Exactly! It keeps for ages, and frying it in oil turns it into a delicacy!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP08_006: Would you like to try space rations?
Affinity_Sparrot_EP08_007: Aaaaargh! What is this dreadful taste?! Remove it at once!!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP09_001: Even now, the Jewel of Tears sometimes shimmers before my eyes...
Affinity_Sparrot_EP09_002: That is what you get for tormenting Aragnia! Serves you right!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP09_003: Tch! What do you expect from a pirate?!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP09_004: Shall I bring you some of the pearls the Elves sell?
Affinity_Sparrot_EP09_005: I have no interest in those fake pearls! What I need is the Jewel of Tears that will multiply my fortune!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP09_006: You said it appears only to those who never seek to possess it. Try letting go of your desire.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP09_007: Hmm~ Then you mean it may someday tumble back into my grasp? That is worth trying!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP10_001: What do you think is indispensable to life at sea?
Affinity_Sparrot_EP10_003: Oh? You know your subject. When the sea surrounds you on every side, nothing matters more than keeping your mind intact.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP10_005: Your answer is correct, Master, but it is not the answer I wanted. Heh heh.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP10_007: What nonsense are you spouting in a pirate's world, where plunder and hostage taking are standard practice?
Affinity_Sparrot_EP11_001: Can you imitate a pirate, Master? Let me hear it.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP11_003: How can you sound so uncertain?! Say it again with spirit!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP11_004: Can you imitate a pirate, Master? Let me hear it.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP11_005: I told you to imitate a pirate, not to repeat my words!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP11_006: Give me a ship's horn. I will blow it.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP11_007: Yo-ho! Every other pirate nearby would flee in terror.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP12_001: Grr... Some brat hurled the insult 'birdbrain' at me.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP12_002: And then? Did you hit them? Did you win?
Affinity_Sparrot_EP12_003: Of course I gave the brat what for! One knock on the head sent them running away in tears. Yaaaarrr!!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP12_004: Is that not accurate? You are a Feathered Beastfolk, Sparrot, so it does not seem entirely wrong.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP12_005: Aaaaargh! How dare the Master say such a thing to a descendant of the Feathers!!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP12_006: Tell me if it happens again. I will give them a stern talking-to.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP12_007: Master, sometimes fists are faster than words. One knock on the head can be more effective than wasting time on a lecture.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP13_001: Master, are you not curious about my exploits from my days with the Parrot Pirates? Yaarrr!!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP13_002: At most, you probably traded a few childish taunts.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP13_003: Yaaaarrr! Childish taunts?! Do not underestimate a pirate's spirit and psychological warfare!!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP13_004: I already know them. Such as when you first came to raid the Bread Cruiser, or when you confronted Aragnia...
Affinity_Sparrot_EP13_005: See here, Master. Why are all your examples stories in which I suffered? Choose something more impressive if you mean to give examples!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP13_006: What? Do you mean you have fought an even more thrilling duel than your recent battle with Callamori?
Affinity_Sparrot_EP13_007: Heh heh heh... That curiosity in your eyes makes the tale worth telling! Open your ears wide, Master!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP14_001: Someday I shall become the Pirate King who rules all pirates!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP14_002: I am glad such a charismatic pirate is on our side.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP14_003: Heh heh heh. Consider yourself fortunate to have the most formidable pirate backing you, Master!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP14_004: May I hear your specific plan?
Affinity_Sparrot_EP14_005: Uh... A plan... I have not thought about anything like that yet...
Affinity_Sparrot_EP14_006: You cannot become Pirate King without even a network of Beastfolk among your crew.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP14_007: Master, you should consider yourself fortunate that you are my employer.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP15_001: Heh heh heh, Master. Do you know how many gold coins my old wanted poster offered?
Affinity_Sparrot_EP15_002: I do not know the exact amount... but was your bounty not the highest among all pirates?
Affinity_Sparrot_EP15_003: Yes. It surely was! Of course, I only ever saw my own wanted poster, so I do not know the others' bounties.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP15_004: Huh? Sparrot, were you truly that famous?
Affinity_Sparrot_EP15_005: You spent time at sea and never heard of the Parrot Pirates who ruled the Capricious Sea?
Affinity_Sparrot_EP15_006: You scoundrel! Come with me to the police station at once!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP15_007: Heh heh. I do not stay rooted in one place like treasure. I have finished my meal, so I shall take my leave!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP16_001: How should I manage discontent among my crew? Master, tell me your method!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP16_002: First, listen carefully to what troubles them and resolve it through ample discussion...
Affinity_Sparrot_EP16_003: Was it the Elves? That is the sort of dreary advice one finds in their self-help books.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP16_004: Use overwhelming charisma so they have no opportunity to become dissatisfied.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP16_005: Yaarrr! A method perfectly suited to the captain of the Iron Parrot Privateers!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP16_006: What could your crew possibly be dissatisfied with? I have never had that problem.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP16_007: Master, do not lie. Discontent between a captain and the crew is unavoidable.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP17_001: Heh heh heh. I managed to earn a tidy sum again today.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP17_002: Do not tell me you went plundering! Do you want me to pull your cheeks?
Affinity_Sparrot_EP17_003: Grr, Master! Would you inflict torture worthy of the vilest pirate?! And I did not plunder anyone!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP17_004: Then you can use that money to pay for today's meal.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP17_005: Hmph! I already know meals are free here!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP17_007: Some rubbish drifting in the sea bothered me, so I picked it up. Then a Sprite came by, praised me, and gave me a reward.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP18_001: What do you think of the pirate problem, Master?
Affinity_Sparrot_EP18_002: I think they pose a considerable threat to the Bread Cruiser. But with you here now, I am not worried.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP18_003: Hahaha! What a needless question. With the captain of the Iron Parrot Privateers here, you need not fear pirates!! Yaarrr!!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP18_004: It hardly seems worth worrying about.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP18_005: Act that carelessly at sea and you will be robbed of everything you own, Master.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP18_006: Digital piracy is certainly a serious problem.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP18_007: Digital piracy? What are you talking about?! Whatever it is, it has nothing to do with the pirates I mean!!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP19_001: See here, Master. Have you ever accomplished anything by making use of that long body of yours?
Affinity_Sparrot_EP19_003: What a waste. Make an effort to use that long body of yours for something.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP19_004: I can take your favorite dish down from the shelf right now.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP19_005: Yaarrr! Now that is a talent I appreciate! Bring it here at once!
Affinity_Sparrot_EP19_006: Looking down at all of you from above?
Affinity_Sparrot_EP19_007: Is that how you usually look down on us? Well, taking the superior position is a virtue every captain should possess.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP20_001: It seems the cannon will soon need repairs. I should inspect it after leaving here.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP20_002: Are bombs not more important than cannons?
Affinity_Sparrot_EP20_003: If the cannon malfunctions, it may not fire at all. Have you never handled firearms?
Affinity_Sparrot_EP20_004: Do you climb directly into the cannon's bore to clean it?
Affinity_Sparrot_EP20_005: You know nothing about it. Do that and your cheeks will become wedged inside the cannon.
Affinity_Sparrot_EP20_006: I know an excellent mechanic. Shall I introduce you?
Affinity_Sparrot_EP20_007: Yo-ho? With a mechanic's help... perhaps the cannon could be modified as well as repaired! Introduce me at once!!
